_status: No default brand. 'wein-qrit' is a TEST brand kept only as a filled-in example: never apply it unless the user names it. For a real brand, ask (name, colours, logo, tone, voice) and add an entry.

wein-qrit.what: Social network app to find your school / lycée and reconnect with classmates (Algeria).
wein-qrit.tone: Warm, playful, nostalgic, friendly. Simple darija, short sentences.

logo.description: Coral map pin with a cream face (two ink eyes) wearing an ink graduation cap with a sunflower tassel; wordmark وين قريت in Lalezar, ink.
logo.status: Drawn for the first promo — TODO: confirm it is the official logo or provide the real one

wein-qrit.mascot: The pin character (blinks, hops, looks around).
wein-qrit.music: Upbeat pop ~120 BPM, marimba motif F-A-C, playful pops and whooshes.
wein-qrit.visual_style: Flat vector (mg-styles-15 / 01-flat-vector rules), bold flat palette above, elastic motion.
wein-qrit.end_card: Pin logo with cap + وين قريت + رجّع صحاب القراية + WEIN QRIT (TODO: store links / handle)
do: Always show at least one real-feeling school moment (bell, classroom, cap toss)
dont: No real school names or real people without permission
No invented features, prices or user numbers
wein-qrit._note: Test / example only (made to try the skills on 2026-11-20).

defaults.captions: on for social versions, off for 16:9 unless asked
